dedupe_keys.name: large scale green grabbing for wind and solar pv development in brazil

description: Michael Klingler and colleagues publish R code and a partial data collection for analysis of Brazilian wind and solar photovoltaic development, land tenure and park ownership or investment relationships. The native description distinguishes usable land-tenure comparison scripts from procedures requiring unavailable inputs. Owner-investor diagrams cannot be reproduced from the deposit alone, and validation requires proprietary Bloomberg data. Other inputs are not publicly shareable or require separate manual collection. This resource is therefore a partial infrastructure land-tenure analysis bundle, not the complete underlying ownership database. Zenodo provides free open access under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Brazil; park counts, observation years, spatial resolution and complete file schemas are not specified in the inspected description. Related renewable-energy resources do not resolve these missing inputs. No code, spatial file or proprietary data were downloaded, and reproducibility was not tested.
